reading.title: Climate Change and Ocean Acidification
reading.passage: Ocean acidification is a critical consequence of climate change that occurs when carbon dioxide from the atmosphere dissolves in seawater, forming carbonic acid. This process lowers the ocean's pH level, making it more acidic. Marine organisms with calcium carbonate shells, such as corals and mollusks, are particularly vulnerable to these changes. The increasing acidity interferes with their ability to build and maintain their shells, threatening entire marine ecosystems and the food chains that depend on them.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary cause of ocean acidification?
options: Carbon dioxide from the atmosphere dissolving in seawater
questions.explanation: 글에서 대기의 이산화탄소가 해수에 용해되어 해양산성화를 일으킨다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which marine organisms are mentioned as being particularly vulnerable to ocean acidification?
questions.explanation: 산호와 연체동물(mollusks)이 탄산칼슘 껍질을 가지고 있어 산성화에 특히 취약하다고 설명되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does ocean acidification interfere with?
options: Marine organisms' ability to build and maintain shells
questions.explanation: 글의 마지막 부분에서 산성화가 해양생물의 껍질 형성 및 유지 능력을 방해한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made our lives better, but it has also created more problems than it solved.'

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (동의/불동의)과 주요 이유 2-3개를 간단히 제시하세요.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장: 기술의 긍정적 영향 또는 부정적 영향에 대한 구체적 예시 제시
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장: 대조되는 관점 또는 보완적 논거를 구체적 근거와 함께 설명
structure.conclusion: 초반 입장을 재확인하면서 양측의 주장을 종합적으로 정리하고 최종 의견 도출

useful_phrases: I strongly agree/disagree with the statement

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in large companies with many employees. Others prefer to work in small companies or as self-employed individuals. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer to work in a small company because...
One reason is that small companies offer more personal attention and opportunities for growth.
Another advantage is that I would have more flexibility and independence in my work decisions.
Furthermore, the work environment is usually more collaborative and less hierarchical.
On the other hand, larger companies provide job security and comprehensive benefits.
sample_points: 소규모 회사는 더 많은 개인적 관심과 빠른 경력 발전 기회를 제공합니다. 직원들이 적기 때문에 개인의 기여가 더 눈에 띄고, 다양한 경험을 쌓을 수 있습니다.
소규모 회사나 자영업은 업무 방식과 스케줄에 대한 더 큰 자율성과 유연성을 제공합니다. 이를 통해 개인의 창의성과 혁신적 사고를 더 발휘할 수 있습니다.

listening.title: University Recycling Program Discussion
listening.script: Student: Hi Professor, I'm interested in starting a recycling program on campus. Could you give me some advice? Professor: That's a wonderful initiative! First, you'll need to survey students to understand their current recycling habits and identify barriers. Second, partner with your facilities department—they manage waste collection. Third, create an awareness campaign with posters and workshops. Many students don't recycle simply because they're unaware of the environmental impact. You should also consider incentivizing participation, perhaps with small rewards or recognition. Finally, track your progress with metrics so you can demonstrate success to the administration. Student: This is really helpful. How long do you think this project would take? Professor: If you're persistent, you could launch a pilot program within three to four months. Start small with one or two locations, then expand based on feedback.

questions.q: What is the main topic of this conversation?
options: How to organize a campus environmental club
Advice on starting a university recycling program
The negative impact of waste on the environment
How to work with the facilities department
questions.explanation: 학생이 캠퍼스 재활용 프로그램을 시작하려는 의도를 밝히고, 교수가 구체적인 조언을 제공하는 것이 주요 주제입니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what is one reason why students don't recycle?
options: Recycling facilities are too far away
Students lack awareness of environmental impact
questions.explanation: 교수가 '많은 학생들은 단순히 환경 영향에 대한 인식이 없어서 재활용하지 않는다'고 명시적으로 언급합니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest as a way to encourage participation?
options: Making recycling mandatory for all students
Requiring a recycling class for all students
questions.explanation: 교수는 작은 보상이나 인정(small rewards or recognition)을 통해 참여를 장려할 수 있다고 제안했습니다.
